newsitem.title: USA: Home Federal votes stock split, higher dividend.
newsitem.headline: Home Federal votes stock split, higher dividend.

text.p: Home Federal Bancorp said its directors voted a three-for-two stock split, under which every two shares of its common stock outstanding at the close of business on December 6, 1996, will be converted into three shares of common stock.

Directors also voted to increase the company's quarterly dividend rate by 20 percent. A dividend of $0.10 a share will be paid on January 3, 1997, to shareholders of record on December 23, 1996. This quarterly dividend is equal to $0.15 a share on a pre-split basis.
The stock split is payable December 20.
Home Federal last split its stock in a three-for-two exchange in September of 1993.
The split will result in the issuance of about 1,118,341 new shares of stock, bringing the total shares outstanding to 3,355,023.
Home Federal is one bank holding company with Home Federal Savings Bank as its sole subsidiary.
